name: Spain
shortSummary: Spain's partnership with India gained significant momentum through the 2022 Tata-Airbus C295 military transport aircraft manufacturing agreement, establishing India's first private-sector military aircraft assembly line.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: The Vadodara C295 facility anchors growing India-Spain defence-industrial cooperation.
Spanish firms are active in Indian wind and solar power development.

recentDevelopments.title: C295 aircraft manufacturing ramps up in Vadodara
recentDevelopments.description: The Airbus-Tata C295 final assembly line in Vadodara continued production, delivering aircraft for the Indian Air Force.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: A flagship "Make in India" defence-manufacturing success story anchoring the wider relationship.

historicalEvents.title: C295 Aircraft Manufacturing Agreement
historicalEvents.description: Tata Advanced Systems and Airbus Spain finalise a deal to manufacture C295 military transport aircraft in Vadodara, India — the first time a private Indian company will assemble military aircraft domestically.
historicalEvents.impact: Marked a milestone for India's "Make in India" defence manufacturing push.

agreements.name: C295 Transport Aircraft Programme
agreements.description: Airbus-Tata joint programme to manufacture C295 aircraft in India for the Indian Air Force and export markets.

defenceCooperation.name: C295 aircraft manufacturing
defenceCooperation.description: India's first private-sector military aircraft final assembly line, based in Vadodara, Gujarat.
